# Cleveland 2003.171, Saints Peter and Paul initial

Saints Peter and Paul in the initial Q and its border foliage, excised from a South Flemish antiphonary of about 1325, in the Cleveland Museum of Art.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `cma-2003-171`, historical, 5 assets.
